# SIDE SCRIPT - not a pipeline step, deliberately excluded from run-all.R.
#
# Figures for talks, at presentation rather than manuscript proportions. It is
# the only consumer of data/results-vars.RData, the save.image() dump written
# at the end of 05-results.qmd, so 05 must have been rendered before this runs.
#
# Inputs:  data/results-vars.RData (from 05), data/csi_dat.rds (from 03)
# Outputs: none saved - figures render inline
#
#--------------------------------------------
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r}
#| label: load-libraries-and-data

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

source(here::here("analysis", "0-config.R"))
load(here("data", "results-vars.RData"))

csi_dat <- readRDS(here("data", "csi_dat.rds"))
```

```{r}
#| label: base-map

niger_adm2 <- niger_adm2 %>%
  filter(adm1_name == "Dosso") %>%
  st_make_valid()

base_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.25) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  annotation_scale() +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Longitude") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Latitude") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: villages-map

base_map +
  geom_point(data = df_all, aes(x = lon, y = lat), 
  size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, color = "darkgoldenrod2") +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.4)

ggsave(here("results", "figs", "slides-villages_map.png") , width = 4.5, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")

```


```{r}
#| label: tx-assignment-map

base_map +
  geom_point(data = df_all, aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = isTreated_child), 
  size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.25) +
  scale_color_manual(breaks = c("Control", "Treatment"),
                     values = c("#fecd6c", "#e84d60"),
                     name = "Treatment Arm") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))

ggsave(here("results", "figs", "slides-treatment_assignment_map.png") , width = 4.5, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")

```

```{r}
#| label: mortality-rate-grappes-maps-by-arm

base_map +
  geom_point(data = df_all, aes(x = lon, y = lat, 
  color = deaths_per_1000_1to59,
  size = deaths_per_1000_1to59),
             alpha = 0.3) +
              facet_wrap(~isTreated_child) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 60),
                      na.value = NA,
                      breaks = seq(0,60,by=20),
                      option = "mako", direction = 1,
                      begin = 0.2, end = 1,
                      guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white"))  +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3.5)) +
  guides(size = "none")

ggsave(here("results", "figs", "slides-mortality_rate_maps_by_arm.png") , width = 6, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

```{r}
#| label: mortality-rate-districts-maps-by-arm

dist_summ_long <- dist_summ %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(MortRateControl, MortRateTreatment), names_to = "tx_group", values_to = "mort_rate", names_prefix = "MortRate") %>%
  left_join(niger_adm2_sub, by = c("district" = "adm2_name"))

base_map +
  geom_sf(data = dist_summ_long, aes(fill = mort_rate, geometry = geometry), color = NA, size = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~tx_group) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 35),
                      na.value = NA,
                      breaks = seq(0,30,by=10),
                      guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white"))

ggsave(here("results", "figs", "slides-mortality_rate_maps.png") , width = 6, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")

```

```{r}
#| label: model-prediction-maps-by-arm

raster_df$tx_group <- factor(raster_df$tx_group, levels = c("Control", "Treatment"), ordered = TRUE)

ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = subset(raster_df, model == "Gen + int"), aes(x = x, y = y, fill = pred), na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  facet_grid(~tx_group) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  annotation_scale() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 35),
                      na.value = NA,
                      breaks = seq(0,30,by=10),
                      guide=guide_colorbar(title="Modeled mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white")) +
                                            scale_x_continuous(name = "Longitude") +
                                            scale_y_continuous(name = "Latitude")

ggsave(here("results", "figs", "slides-model_mort_pred.png"), bg = "white", width = 6, height = 5, units = "in")
```

```{r}
#| label: dist-avg-and-model-prediction-control

dist_avg_panel <- base_map +
  geom_sf(data = subset(dist_summ_long, tx_group == "Control"), aes(fill = mort_rate, geometry = geometry), color = NA, size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 35),
                      na.value = NA,
                      breaks = seq(0,30,by=10),
                      guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white"))

dist_avg_panel

pred_panel <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = subset(raster_df, model == "Gen + int" & tx_group == "Control"), aes(x = x, y = y, fill = pred), na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2, fill = NA, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.25) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  annotation_scale() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
  axis.text.y = element_blank(),
  axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 35),
                      na.value = NA,
                      breaks = seq(0,30,by=10),
                      guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white")) +
                                            scale_x_continuous(name = "Longitude") +
                                            scale_y_continuous(name = "Latitude")+
                                            guides(fill = "none")

pred_panel

dist_avg_panel + pred_panel + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(here("results", "figs", "slides-dist_avg_and_model_pred.png"), bg = "white", width = 7, height = 5, units = "in")

```

```{r}
#| label: ate-district-avg-map

  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, aes(fill = ATE, geometry = geometry), color = NA, size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = muted("dodgerblue"),
```

```{r}
#| label: csi-location-map

csi_global <- st_transform(csi_dat, crs = st_crs(niger_adm2)) %>%
  mutate(lon = st_coordinates(geometry)[,1],
         lat = st_coordinates(geometry)[,2])

n_per_csi <- df_all %>%
  group_by(csi) %>%
  summarise(n = n())

summary(n_per_csi$n)

base_map +
  geom_point(data = df_all, aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = csi), 
             size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank())

ggsave(here("results", "figs", "slides-csi_map1.png") , width = 4.5, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")

base_map +
  geom_point(data = df_all, aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = csi), 
             size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = csi_global, aes(x = lon, y = lat), size = 0.5, shape = 4) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank()) 

ggsave(here("results", "figs", "slides-csi_map2.png") , width = 4.5, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")

```

```{r}
#| label: csi-mortality-map

csi_global <- csi_global %>%
  mutate(deaths_per_1000_1to59 = (n_deaths_1to59 * 1000) / pt_year_1to59)

base_map +
  geom_sf(data = csi_global, aes(color = deaths_per_1000_1to59, size = deaths_per_1000_1to59, geometry = geometry), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 50),
                      na.value = NA,
                      breaks = seq(0,50,by=10),
                      option = "mako", direction = 1,
                      begin = 0.2, end = 1,
                      guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mortality rate\n(per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white"))  +
  # scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 3.5)) +
  guides(size = "none")

ggsave(here("results", "figs", "slides-csi_mortality_map.png") , width = 4.5, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")

```
